scopeNotes: 覆盖该次 E 的初始伤害、完整轮转伤害任务链，以及属于其实际寒病鬼差状态实例的协同攻击；revelation=0 时协同监听器未注册，零次触发合法。
轮转链依据实际 expired／replaced／emit 分支闭合；协同攻击依据实际 E 状态替换、移除或到期闭合。不同 E 的实际状态实例与任务归属分别核对。
Stellar 原源码仍注明轮转／治疗帧数为近似估计，以及祭礼剑重放按仅一个实例处理的 TODO；本契约复现固定源码，不代表游戏实测。
治疗、粒子、C1 回能、受治疗加成、反应增益、Q 与 C6 对其他角色反应追加基础伤害另计。
qiqi.nativePointerSemantics: Stellar captures separate aiTick and snapTick pointers, passes the original pointer pair recursively, and invokes QueueAttackWithSnap by value at each actual emission. Do not import classic AttackEvent-copy code or117 occurrence wrapper.
callbacks: c1RevelationCB adds energy only after original getRadiance check

ownedGenerator.activation: synchronous within Skill before skillLastUsed assignment and initial task registration
ownedGenerator.revelationDisabled: status generator still registered, zero triggers expected/valid
ownedGenerator.ending: exact actual status instance replacement/removal or native expiry; source adds901f non-hitlag status

qiqi.listenerRegistration: Only when revelation true; default profile parameter is1. No new event wrapping/registration/filter or ICD changes.
qiqi.icd: 132f hitlag-affected status on current active character, added before original AttackInfo and pattern construction
qiqi.snapshotAndOrder: Owned trigger wrapper encloses only original positive queue after ai/ap construction. Original QueueAttack 1/1 and original particleCB,c1CB,c1RevelationCB ordering preserved.
qiqi.otherSourceScope: Stellar burst additional SSC queue and C6 stacks belong to Q. C6 listener modifies FlatDmg of other on-field actors direct stellar attacks, creates no new E queue. A1 heal bonus, A4 talisman, C2 stats and revelation reaction bonuses remain modifiers/healing.
qiqi.nativeDependency: RegisterOwnedGenerator original frozen implementation was Q-only; sibling native patch supplies exact current E invocation registration, retaining delayed-Q fallback.

scopeNotes: 覆盖该次 E 新建杀生樱的完整原生任务链、替换第四柱时本次施放产生的 A1 雷击，以及该图腾强化雷击的实际命中追击。
每个 E 的任务沿创建时原生图腾指针继承；任务区分已删除、无目标、敌人、机关，必须观察到期任务和最终零子任务后才闭合。
revelation 默认开启，原生图腾寿命增加600帧，Q不销毁图腾；revelation关闭时保留原生Q销毁行为，不强行套用经典生命周期。
强化追击要求原生revelationEnhanceDMG实际返回回调；每个父雷击队列至多由一次成功敌人命中回调追加一击。槽位存在性使用返回值事实，不重读启示或Radiance条件。
额外天狐霆雷属于Q；独立普攻、反应、武器／圣遗物伤害及粒子、能量、队伍增益另计。
yaemiko.pointerOwnership: Exactly one fresh *kitsune per spawn; first tick, expiry and next tick retain original pointer through closures. Source still pops oldest in expiry if captured k is not deleted. No invented pointer-ID/gadget or cleanup path.

producerTiming.expiryAfterSpawn: kitsuneDur + revelationBonusSkillDur() - skillStart =866 or1466; original getter calls retained

yaemiko.noRepeatedReads: Original target selectors, sakuraLevel, revelationEnhanceDMG, isRadianceSSC and c6DefIgnore calls are unchanged; extra observation only checks the already returned callback value and writes source-proven branch counts.

spawnA1.ownership: new E spawn owns this attack; older removed totem does not

enhancementCallback.presentFactSource: nil/non-nil result of the one original revelationEnhanceDMG call, stored before native QueueAttack
enhancementCallback.onceScope: at most one positive callback per exact parent tick queue; done closure is created afresh for each returned enhancement callback, not shared across all E ticks
positiveGates: native done false, then sets done true
enhancementCallback.missingFactBehavior: Unknown/fail; do not infer absent callback from current radiance, status, or queued strike count.

yaemiko.helperAudit: revelationInit only installs status on Superconduct/StellarConduct. revelationEnhanceDMG checks revelation/status/ICD then consumes enhancement status and computes flatDMG; if original isRadianceSSC is false, no callback. When true, returned closure owns its own done flag and queues one child after first actual enemy hit. C1 reaction hooks, C2 stat/range/level, C4 buff/energy and C6 modifiers do not emit extra attacks.
yaemiko.QBehavior: kitsuneBurst uses Q invocation; popAllKitsune only when !revelation, preserving live E tasks otherwise.
